h1: How Aena manages more than 2 million WiFi connections with a scalable digital experience
sub: Aena relies on Flame Analytics to offer a simple and secure WiFi access experience across its airport network, manage millions of connections and gain valuable insight into traveler behavior.

quote.text: Connectivity is an essential service for improving the passenger experience and a key source of information for optimizing airport management.
quote.author: Digital Transformation team

elCaso: Aena, operator of the largest airport network in Spain, continues to drive the digital transformation of its infrastructure through solutions that improve the passenger experience and optimize the management of its digital services.
As part of this strategy, the company deployed a Guest WiFi platform integrated with its CRM together with Flame Analytics to manage millions of connections in a high-availability environment.

The project responds to a twofold goal: to offer simple and scalable WiFi access for passengers and to have information that makes it possible to better understand traveler behavior across the entire airport network.

blocks.h2: Managing millions of connections with a simple access experience

body.p: Every day, millions of passengers use airport WiFi connectivity to check flight information, access digital services, work or stay connected during their trip.
Managing this volume of connections requires an infrastructure capable of guaranteeing availability, performance and a consistent experience across all airports.
Aena was looking for a solution that would:

list: Manage more than 2 million WiFi connections centrally.
Guarantee a high-availability, highly scalable service.
Provide fast, simple access for passengers.
Integrate the platform with its CRM.
Automate campaigns and communications aimed at users.
Gain information on travelers' behavior and usage patterns.

body.quote: The goal was to turn the WiFi service into a strategic platform to improve the passenger experience and generate data-driven business intelligence.

blocks.h2: A Guest WiFi platform ready for a large-scale airport network

body.p: Flame Analytics deployed a Guest WiFi platform integrated with Aena's CRM that makes it possible to centrally manage wireless access across the entire airport network.

In addition to making Internet access easier, the platform makes it possible to automate commercial processes, manage the relationship with users and have real-time information to optimize operations.

body.h3: An infrastructure ready for millions of connections

body.p: The solution has been designed to operate in a high-availability environment and support millions of connections, guaranteeing a consistent experience for passengers and centralized administration of the entire WiFi infrastructure.

blocks.h2: A connected digital experience for millions of passengers

body.p: With the implementation of Flame Analytics, Aena offers a simpler, faster and more consistent WiFi access experience for passengers across its entire airport network.
The platform makes it possible to manage the service centrally, automate communication actions and have real-time information to continuously improve the traveler experience.
Thanks to the CRM integration and segmentation capabilities, Aena can offer more relevant communications and optimize the relationship with users during their time at the airport.

body.h3: From WiFi access to traveler knowledge

body.p: The project marks a further step in Aena's digital transformation strategy.

Connectivity stops being merely a service for passengers and becomes a platform that makes it possible to better understand traveler behavior, automate commercial campaigns and support decision-making through real-time information.

body.quote: Thanks to Flame Analytics, Aena combines a high-quality digital experience with centralized, scalable and data-driven management.
